Title: New networking features now available in all regions

Body.Content:
The following networking features which were announced at Ignite 2015:
  • User-defined routes
  • Multiple IPs per cloud service
  • Ability to move reserved IPs from one service to another
  • DNS names for public IPs
are now available in all regions in public cloud (see full list below):
  • US East 2
  • US South
  • US West
  • Asia SouthEast
  • Europe North
  • Europe West
  • North Central US
  • Japan East
  • Japan West
  • Australia East
  • Australia Southeast
  • Brazil South
  • US East
  • Asia East
  • Central US
